newsitem.title: USA: Effective Management expands in China.
newsitem.headline: Effective Management expands in China.

text.p: Effective Management Systems Inc, which makes software for manufacturers to manage production, order taking, and inventory, said Monday it will expand its software distribution in China through a joint marketing agreement.

EMS said it entered into a joint marketing agreement under which Shenyang Dawn Group Inc will distribute EMS software in China. Dawn Group, located in Shenyang, distributes computer hardware and software products. Its sales network includes 20 branches scattered throughout mainland China.
Under terms of a joint marketing agreement, EMS said Dawn Group placed a significant amount of committed orders for EMS' software for prospective customers in China. The amount was not disclosed.

"Our agreement with the Dawn Group is another significant step in building our presence in Asia, which we have been doing steadily since 1994," said Michael Dunham, president and chief executive officer of EMS, in a statement.
"This will augment our existing relationships in China and greatly intensify our sales and marketing efforts there."
